description: This file is a C header (.h) file defining function prototypes and forward declarations related to preloading and reading an index in a version control system. It declares external data structures and functions used for index preloading and repository index reading.

methods.name: preload_index
methods.description: Function to preload an index with specified path specifications and refresh flags.

methods.name: repo_read_index_preload
methods.description: Function to read the index from a repository with specified path specifications and refresh flags.
